name: Theros
description: Theros is a plane ruled by a pantheon of gods and filled with monsters, where mortals endure and thrive in walled city-states.

description_citations.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Theros is a plane ruled by a pantheon of gods and filled with monsters, where mortals endure and thrive in walled city-states.

citations.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Mortals live behind the walls of great poleis, each a bulwark against raging monsters, and Meletis is one of its cities.

citations.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Ajani travels across Theros reflecting on gods and on Naya.

citations.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

bio.text: Elspeth Tirel is first encountered there by Ashiok, who sought her in the Underworld, and the God of Destiny artificially creates Calix on Theros to keep her from escaping it.

citations.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.
"Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Niko is born on Theros to a destiny they never chose and escapes to follow their own path through the Multiverse.

citations.text: "Nico Aris". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: The material gives no final state for Theros; its last relevant events are Elspeth's origins and Calix's creation there, and the plane is still described as ruled by gods with mortals in walled city-states.

citations.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At night Leandros asks Mnesos why the gods have abandoned them and whether they will return; Mnesos says the gods have retreated into Nyx before.
timeline.quote: The historians tell us that this is not the first time the gods have retreated into Nyx

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: In a city's dream, small hairy creatures overrun a content, resting city, which is driven to awaken by a voice.
timeline.quote: Every avenue and structure of the city was covered with the hairy pests

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: The city awakens as Cacophony, god of cities, and begins crushing the ape-like humans clinging to its body.
timeline.quote: Cacophony, the god of cities, arose.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ephara appears, calls Cacophony a monstrosity and plunges her hands into it, draining its life; the god of cities never wakes again.
timeline.quote: Cacophony, the god of cities dark, never woke again.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok recalls repaying a favor to Phenax with a boon to hide from the gods, and Phenax's warning not to use it to harm a god.
timeline.quote: The boon was a temporary one, and Phenax had been very explicit about Ashiok's fate if Ashiok used the boon to attempt to injure or murder a god.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reflects that turning an idea into a god is easy compared to Xenagos's feat, and that Cacophony could rise again.
timeline.quote: But turning an idea into a god was much easier.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani travels across Theros, reflecting on gods and on Naya, and camps in the mountains hoping leonin will find him.
timeline.quote: He made camp in the fading light, without stealth or subterfuge.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani notices the night sky lacks its usual constellations and has a void where no star shines.
timeline.quote: Worse, in one corner of the sky, there was simply blankness, a void where no star shone.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
timeline.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora dives beneath the waves as Thassa, as the Great Eye, bursts from the water.
timeline.quote: Kiora cast a spell to aid her swimming

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: On the sea bed Kiora calls to the krakens and leviathans Thassa kept in the deep and summons sea-beasts from many worlds.
timeline.quote: she gathered to her the essence of every sea-beast she had ever called her own.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora rises with her armada and sees Thassa on the Monsoon; Thassa sends Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
timeline.quote: Thassa stepped off the deck of the Monsoon

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Thassa shifts into her triton form and summons the krakens of Theros as Arixmethes sides with her.
timeline.quote: He was also, for the moment, on Thassa's side.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: The two armies clash as hundreds of tritons arrive to watch; Thassa taunts Kiora.
timeline.quote: "Bear witness to the fall of the pretender!"

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tries to wrest Arixmethes from Thassa by bonding with his mind, but fails.
timeline.quote: You are not mine

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora's serpent turns on her and devours dozens of tritons, and half her krakens turn against her.
timeline.quote: devouring dozens in one bite.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora banishes her serpent and the traitor krakens and falls, cushioning her fall with roots and vines from the sea floor.
timeline.quote: she pulled roots and vines up out of ground that had never seen the sun

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Thassa parts the sea into an arena, accuses Kiora of leading her people astray, and pins her to a boulder with the thrown bident.
timeline.quote: It slammed into her and pinned her to one of the boulders

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora takes the bident and planeswalks away with it, leaving Thassa crying out in anguish.
timeline.quote: melted away into the void, Thassa's weapon still clutched in her hands.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kynaios and Tiro rise together to challenge the tyrant Agnomakhos and rally the people.
timeline.quote: Kynaios and Tiro, joined by their love for one another and for freedom, rose to challenge him.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals to Kydele the nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Kruphix himself revealed to Kydele the true nature of the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse, a sight she can never unsee.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Thrasios leaves Meletis on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths.
timeline.quote: Thrasios has left his home and embarked on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Saskia survives a massacre, builds a stone monument alone for years, then leads thousands to war on her enemies.
timeline.quote: Saskia was the sole survivor of a massacre conducted against her village by an invading army from across the sea.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ravos strikes a deal with Athreos to guide the dead in exchange for yearly visits with his lover.
timeline.quote: Ravos swore to help Athreos guide the dead to the Underworld in exchange for seeing his dead lover once each year.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Saprolings take in the abandoned child Tana and she grows into a feral hunter.
timeline.quote: a pod of fungal saprolings took her in and protected her from the wild

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani carries the dying Elspeth to Theros, then leaves to find help as she sees a flash of light cleaving the heavens.
timeline.quote: The last thing she saw was a flash of light, cleaving the heavens in two.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: "Her name is Elspeth Tirel."

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani correctly guesses Theros is his destination, a first-wave target.
timeline.quote: You want to see Theros.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian forces rain onto Theros, devouring livestock and humans.
timeline.quote: It starts the same as it did on Kamigawa

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn orders Ajani to bring a guardian god of Theros within Phyrexia's embrace and to bring priests and the Argent Etchings.
timeline.quote: Bring priests with you,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ajani departs for Theros while Norn hides her real reason for sending him.
timeline.quote: he did not discover the real reason she'd sent him to Theros.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 1: Triumph of the Fleshless" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Angels pour through the portal to Theros and protect its people, shielding Kaya as she kills the corrupted god Heliod.
timeline.quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself against Nicol Bolas to save Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: he sacrificed himself to save Liliana Vess

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Kytheon kills the other inmates with his magic to defeat Heliod and wins his freedom.
timeline.quote: Kytheon succeeded, but only because his magic killed the other inmates by siphoning their lifeforce to strengthen him.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Adrasteia notices a snarl of two intertwined threads, one blue and one gold, in the weave of the Fates.
timeline.quote: At one point, Adrasteia noticed a particularly large snarl of threads in the weave of the Fates.

citation.text: "Adrasteia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adrasteia decides one thread cannot be saved without harming the other, since their destinies are bound together.
timeline.quote: One without the other could weaken the tapestry, leaving it prone to irreparable tears.

citation.text: "Adrasteia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adrasteia takes out her crooked black shears from a box beneath the table.
timeline.quote: The shears could never be fully closed.

citation.text: "Adrasteia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adrasteia misjudges her snip and cuts off the tip of her thumb, staining the tapestry with a drop of her blood.
timeline.quote: The shears took the snarl, and along with it the very tip of her thumb.

citation.text: "Adrasteia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani tracks Elspeth to Theros.
timeline.quote: he tracked her to the plane of Theros

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth strikes down Xenagos in Nyx.
timeline.quote: the pair battled the god until at last Elspeth struck him down

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod murders Elspeth with her own weapon.
timeline.quote: Heliod appeared and used her weapon to murder Elspeth

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals Heliod's murder in Meletis and spreads the message that gods are creations of belief; he earns his place among Theros's leonin.
timeline.quote: With that, he earned his place amongst the leonin of Theros.

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani compleats at least three of Theros's gods, including Heliod.
timeline.quote: He succeeded in compleating at least three of Theros's gods, including Heliod

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Heliod and Ajani faces off with her.
timeline.quote: After Kaya Cassir appeared on Theros and killed Heliod

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In ancient times the archons of Theros hold a massive empire in the Age of Trax, tyrannizing the world in the belief they imposed strict justice, until their empires fall.
timeline.quote: the archons of Theros held a massive empire, tyrannizing the world in the belief that they were imposing strict justice.

citation.text: "Archon", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod takes pity on an archon and gives it a spear in exchange for the rule of law in the wildest places.
timeline.quote: Heliod took pity on the archon and gave it a spear almost as radiant as his own

citation.text: "Archon", section "Archon of Falling Stars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok comes to Theros drawn by the power of mortals' belief and the darker side of belief, nightmares.
timeline.quote: Ashiok came to Theros because of the strong power of devotion and belief of the plane's mortals

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok bargains with Phenax and seeks to incite war between Iretis and the leonin.
timeline.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax , the god of lies and deceit

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's experiment of disturbing citizens' dreams creates the god Cacophony, whom Ephara quickly slays.
timeline.quote: The newborn god was quickly slain by Ephara

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's nightmares spread, causing magic users to wake with no memory of what they did and be cast out as Ashiok gathers power.
timeline.quote: Ashiok gathered power for the grandest spell

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "A grander scheme". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok plans a Sleep curse over all Theros but Dack, Ravos and the dead put an end to it.
timeline.quote: Dack, Ravos , and the dead put an end to Ashiok's Sleep curse.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "A grander scheme". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok savors Elspeth's twisted dreams and learns of the Phyrexians, then is speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: After being speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear , Ashiok planeswalked away

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods, Athreos becomes inactive, souls cannot be ferried, and Returned accumulate outside the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos, like the other deities of Theros, became inactive.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xenagos returns to Theros to become the god of revels as the boundary with Nyx thins and Nyxborn pour into the mortal world.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Xenagos returns to Theros to become the god of revels.

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mogis sends hordes of minotaurs against Akros, Meletis and Setessa.
timeline.quote: Mogis , the god of slaughter sends hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities Akros , Meletis , and Setessa .

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The God of Destiny artificially creates Calix on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Calix was artificially created by the God of Destiny on the plane of Theros to prevent Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.

citation.text: "Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dack takes a magical gauntlet from the Boros Legion's Sunhome, travels to Theros, finds the other half and defeats a kraken.
timeline.quote: Fayden slipped on the completed gauntlet, felt an ancient power within him, and defeated the sea creature.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack learns he will be affected by the Sleep Curse and enters Theros's Underworld.
timeline.quote: was last seen entering a portal to Theros's Underworld

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lidia takes Daxos to Athreos; he speaks and is revealed to be an oracle; Erebos sends Athreos to claim him.
timeline.quote: Athreos was sent to claim the child

citation.text: "Daxos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, helped by Daxos, slays Polukranos, becoming Heliod's champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth engaged the hydra with the help of Daxos and succeeded where many had failed, slaying it

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Godsend". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daxos is freed from the Underworld as one of the Returned, searching for Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Daxos was freed from the Underworld in a cruel bargain with Erebos

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Daxos the Returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daxos fights in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Daxos fought in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Demigod". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights in gladiatorial pits in exile.
timeline.quote: she began fighting in gladiatorial pits, misusing her training as a knight to win.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Vengeance and Redemption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth flees Heliod with the Sword of Chaos, which he later remakes into Godsend.
timeline.quote: he transformed the blade into a spear he dubbed Godsend

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth slays the hydra Polukranos and becomes Heliod's champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth engaged the hydra with the help of Daxos and succeeded where so many had failed, slaying it.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Daxos realize their feelings after Akros is saved.
timeline.quote: Daxos and Elspeth finally realize their feelings for each other.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xenagos controls Elspeth; she kills the Obliterator in her memory and realizes she has killed Daxos.
timeline.quote: only realizing too late that she had just killed Daxos

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod turns against Elspeth, believing she was part of Xenagos's plan.
timeline.quote: Heliod was wroth, believing she was implicit in Xenagos's plan, and sought to destroy her.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Callaphe is revealed to be the planeswalker Kiora.
timeline.quote: Callaphe revealed that her identity was a falsehood and that she was in truth the merfolk planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth smashes the false-life goblet and passes Erebos's ordeal.
timeline.quote: Though it broke her heart, she smashed the cup and passed Erebos's ordeal.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Nyx Elspeth strikes down Xenagos.
timeline.quote: They confronted Xenagos and battled the god until at last Elspeth struck him down

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod fatally wounds Elspeth with her own weapon.
timeline.quote: using her weapon fatally wounded Elspeth

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth drowns in the Underworld until her spark reignites.
timeline.quote: She drowned until her spark reignited in a blinding light.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth pulls Heliod's spear from a nightmare, turning it into Shadowspear.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled Heliod's spear, Khrusor

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Shadowspear acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod yields and Erebos imprisons him in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: The God of the Sun was forced to yield and Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ephara destroys the newborn god Cacophony as a threat to social harmony.
timeline.quote: Ephara personally ended his existence.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods enacted by Kruphix, Ephara withdraws her direct presence from the world.
timeline.quote: Ephara — like her fellow deities — withdrew her direct presence from the world.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Ephara appears in Elesh Norn's vision defending Theros and blesses its champions with godfire.
timeline.quote: She blessed the champions of Theros with divine flame

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Erebos is compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Erebos was compleated.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Theros, the gods battle the titans and seal them in the Underworld, where they remain until they break free.
timeline.quote: The gods of Theros battled them and sealed them away in the Underworld, where they remained until they broke free.

citation.text: "Giant", section "Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
